correctness.rationale: For the locally Lipschitz first-order flow, the observable \(H=a^2/2+xv-\int_0^v f(s)\,ds\) obeys \(\dot H=v^2-Aa^2\) by exact cancellation. Compact invariant measures annihilate its generator and those of \(x^2/2\), \(v^2/2\), \(va\), and \(x\), proving both stationary identities and the weighted secant law. Zero velocity variance forces the equilibrium via invariance and continuity. For \(A\le0\), \(H\) is nondecreasing and on bounded orbits its limit sets lie in the largest invariant zero-drift subset \(\{e\}\); both time directions exclude nontrivial bounded complete trajectories. For \(A>0\), zero-mean periodic velocity and sharp Wirtinger imply \(P\ge2\pi\sqrt A\); equality is exactly fundamental harmonic velocity and requires, and is realized by, critical affine feedback on its whole velocity interval. For \(f(v)=v^2\), a nonnegative weighted cubic factor plus zero mean forces nonzero mass both below \(-1/A\) and above zero, with periodic crossings and strict period inequality. These proofs are analytic, all quantifiers and support assumptions explicit; the actual package checker independently verifies the key differentiations and harmonic substitution, not the infinite dynamical lemmas.

originality.rationale: Complete original-system primary texts from 1997 and 2011, selected relevant pages of the analytical 2002 jerk study, and the full published Goodwin feedback theorem were materially inspected. Each closest result has a different object, feedback coordinate, or only a local Jacobian condition; none of its actual claims implies the combined compact-recurrence obstruction, invariant-measure secant law, or sharp period equality theorem. The uninspected full 2009 piecewise-jerk article and historical multiplier literature remain explicitly recognized possible overlap risks; a failed database search is not treated as novelty proof.
residual_risks: The exact journal text of Kocić–Gegovska-Zajkova (2009) could not be obtained; it discusses a related nonlinear jerk circuit class. The absence of full material prevents a definitive NOT_COVERING judgment for that paper.

Linz (2000) non-chaos criteria and other older third-order ODE multiplier papers were identified but not exhaustively inspected; their potential overlap may affect an individual damping-sign component, though the present combined global secant/equality theorem was not located.

Generic integration-by-parts methods are classical; equivalence of an older general theorem under an unexpected change of variables remains possible. The identified existing position-feedback and Arneodo theorems are not such an implication.

value.rationale: The 1997 quadratic prototype and 2011 generalization are a motivated nonlinear chaotic jerk class, not an arbitrary slice. A single structural coboundary rigorously clarifies the 2011 numerical search for conservative cases over the full locally Lipschitz velocity-feedback family; identifies exactly the global finite-amplitude velocity-feedback secant slope compatible with compact stationary dynamics, agreeing with the local imaginary-pair threshold; establishes a sharp parameter-scaled least-period floor including all equality cases; and requires an unavoidable negative-velocity excursion in the original quadratic model. These are structural, falsifiable constraints and global boundaries for non-equilibrium recurrence rather than numerical table recomputations. The positive-damping results give necessary conditions, not assertions of orbit existence.
